title: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing and network pharmacology reveal the mediation of fisetin on neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Cao, Tingting; Liao, Peiling; Lu, Jia; Liang, Guining; Wei, Qingyan; Song, Wenyi; Lan, Yating; Zeng, Jingyi; Zou, Chun; Pan, Mika; Su, Li; Zou, Donghua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单核RNA测序和网络药理学探讨山奈酚在阿尔茨海默病神经炎症中的作用，虽涉及分子对接但核心是细胞亚群与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by a progressive decline in cognitive function and memory. This study explores cellular subgroups in AD using single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq). It integrates the pharmacological network of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) to identify potential therapeutic targets, providing a theoretical basis for the development of clinical AD. METHODS: We obtained data information from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) for snRNA-seq analysis. Enrichment and pseudotime analysis were performed to explore the functions and differentiation pathways of cellular subgroups. Cellular communication networks were mapped to reveal subgroup interactions. Additionally, a pharmacological network for AD was constructed using the TCM pharmacology database. RESULTS: We identified several cell subgroups associated with AD pathology, contributing to disease progression in various ways. Notably, the TNC(+) CD44(+) astrocyte subgroup activated the I-kappa B kinase/ NF-kappaB signaling pathway, leading to increased expression of inflammatory cytokines. In the pharmacological network, fisetin was identified as a promising compound with the potential to bind to the CD44 protein, mitigating the inflammatory response and preventing further neuronal damage. CONCLUSIONS: By exploring the ecological landscape of various cellular subgroups in AD and investigating the roles and mechanisms, combined with molecular docking and pharmacological network screening, our findings provide new insights and therapeutic possibilities for AD treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's Disease, AD）是一种以认知功能和记忆进行性衰退为特征的神经退行性疾病。本研究利用单核RNA测序（single-nucleus RNA sequencing, snRNA-seq）探索AD中的细胞亚群，并整合中药（traditional Chinese medicine, TCM）药理网络以识别潜在治疗靶点，为AD的临床开发提供理论基础。方法：我们从基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）获取数据信息进行snRNA-seq分析。通过富集分析和伪时间分析探索细胞亚群的功能和分化途径。绘制细胞通讯网络以揭示亚群间相互作用。此外，利用TCM药理学数据库构建了AD的药理网络。结果：我们识别出多个与AD病理相关的细胞亚群，它们以不同方式促进疾病进展。值得注意的是，TNC(+) CD44(+) 星形胶质细胞亚群激活了I-kappa B激酶/NF-kappaB信号通路，导致炎症细胞因子表达增加。在药理网络中，非瑟酮（fisetin）被鉴定为一种有前景的化合物，可能结合CD44蛋白，减轻炎症反应并防止进一步的神经元损伤。结论：通过探索AD中各种细胞亚群的生态景观并研究其作用与机制，结合分子对接和药理网络筛选，我们的发现为AD治疗提供了新的见解和可能性。
